title: The sync gate's held-out reword check does not run when a landing changes only doc2query expansions.csv
goal: rag.py's heldout_rewordings compares held-out rows against the doc2query expansions of the expected articles too, but kg_sync.heldout_checks triggers only on lookup_eval.csv and lookup_heldout.csv, so a landing that adds an expansion rewording a held-out row passes the gate (SP-5x5ut5ko review gap G2, ST-wjm2ipaf). A range that changes a root's _retrieval/doc2query/expansions.csv runs the held-out reword check too.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync;r=kg_sync.heldout_checks(['kb/public/_retrieval/doc2query/expansions.csv']);print('held-out check on an expansions-only range:',r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 3 of 19, "Checks that passed broken work: ledger citations, lint paths, the held-out reword gate and the query-log apply guards"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: kg_sync.heldout_checks(['kb/public/_retrieval/doc2query/expansions.csv']) returns [] (the repro exits 1 on the base, run at planning 2026-10-12). The held-out file beside an expansions.csv is <root>/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv. Refusal run once against today's main: rag.py eval --file kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_heldout.csv --min 1 prints no REWORD line (questions=20 passed=20), so the check does not fire on a state main holds.
